summary: At {workplace}, a sick-leave revision cuts the current allowance and increases what can carry forward.
realLife: During bargaining in Katz the employer announced fewer paid sick days for the year and a higher potential carryover without consulting the union first.
gates: The case record identifies the old and new leave schedules and bargaining dates.
inGame: needs: old and new leave schedules and bargaining dates.

turns.what: The smaller current allowance affects the next absence.
turns.pulledBy: The worker needs leave this year

turns.what: The revised carryover changes the next year's balance.
